notes: Summary: POC completed but lost to Together. Primary reasons: committed on-prem pricing and existing infra connectors; internal buyer prioritized vendor with on-site integration experience.
Timeline:
- 2025-01-09: Intro call AE (Ethan) + Head of ML (Marco). Quick qualify: need low-latency biddable embeddings + creative generation at scale.
- 2025-01-22: Kickoff POC (fireflies FF_2025-01-22). Priya ran infra checklist; security team requested encryption-at-rest details and KMS integration notes.
- 2025-01-28: POC deployed to dev VPC; measured 20% higher token cost vs Together at target batch sizes (our baseline config). Latency within SLA but cost above target.

- 2025-02-05: Security review flagged missing on-prem connector for forensic audit requirement. Redwood proposed private deployment with dedicated tunnels; legal asked for data residency contract addendum.

- 2025-02-10: Exec-level procurement asked for committed monthly GPU pricing. Together offered 12-month reserved capacity with lower effective unit cost; SignalForge procurement pushed back internally.

- 2025-02-13: Internal budget freeze announced for Q1 (hiring/budgets paused). Decision accelerated to evaluate cheaper committed option. No clear champion to fight for Redwood's slightly higher price.
- 2025-02-14: Verbal notice: opting for Together for initial rollout; may revisit Redwood for Optimize tooling or future migrations. AE updated CRM and closed deal as lost to competitor.
Key quotes/communication snippets:
- From Head of ML: 'Great performance — just hard to justify delta on committed spend.'
- From procurement: 'Vendor needs to show on-prem connector + fixed pricing for 12 months. Together gave a clear instrument.'
POC details/metrics:
- Workload: online ranking + creative prompt generation (hybrid chat + completion). Target p99 latency < 120ms for embeddings/rerank path.
- Observed: p95=110ms, p99=170ms under sustained QPS; batching improvements proposed but required dev time.
Sales actions attempted:
- Offered private deployment blueprint and template SOW, provided security FAQ and KMS integration docs.
- Pricing: proposed 10% discount on dedicated commit; competitor offered 22% via 12-month reservation.
- Risk mitigation: outlined fallback routing to smaller models during surges; suggested pilot for Optimize to reduce unit costs — procurement deprioritized.
Why lost (short):
- Competitor commercial packaging (Together) matched their procurement ask: dedicated on-prem/reserved capacity + lower committed unit price.
- No strong internal champion to override procurement given Q1 budget freeze.
- Security team preferred vendor with an already-validated on-prem connector and reference customers in adtech vertical.
Next actions / wind-down notes:
- Close record as closed-lost; set 6-month nurture cadence (AE + SD) targeting infra-refresh window.
- Capture POC learnings into win/loss doc: attach to drive /drive/pricing/signalforge_pricing_discussion_v2.pdf.
- Monitoring: watch for headcount/hiring reopen signals and any public infra refresh announcements.
CRM fragments/other:
- 'Procurement likes predictable committed spend' — repeated in multiple threads.
- CSM: not assigned — consider outreach if they show signs of migration in H2.
- Jira escalations: INF-3321 created for KMS integration questions; closed after brief handoff.
Freeform: feels like classic procurement/commit-vs-flex tradeoff. If we can prototype a 12-month reserved pricing package + a faster on-prem connector story, this account could flip next cycle.
